note: RFC5036 section 2.5.3 item 2.c: the live OpenReceivedKeepAliveEstablishesSession test first proves OPENREC after acceptable Initialization, then requires Operational on peer KeepAlive and timeout-only wire silence. OpenReceivedWaitsForPeerKeepAlive instead withholds that message, requires timeout (not EOF), and pins OPENREC. Reviewed processMessages, handleInit, keepaliveReceived, ReadLoop and runSession; acceptance is not inferred from TCP connect.
